# Button

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

actions · tier 1 · beta · renders on the server and ships no client JavaScript.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For anything the user does on the page: submit, save, confirm, open a dialog. For going
somewhere else, keep Button and pass `render={<Link href="/x" />}` - it stays a real
anchor, so middle-click and "open in new tab" still work.

```tsx
<Button tone="danger" variant="soft" size="sm">Delete</Button>
<Button render={<Link href="/docs" />}>Read the docs</Button>
<Button loading>Saving</Button>
```

`loading` and `disabled` both block the button. `loading` keeps full colour and
announces itself with `aria-busy`; `disabled` dims it. A disabled `render={<a>}`
loses its `href`, so it cannot be followed.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { Button } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | - | The label, and any icon beside it. |
| `fullWidth` | no | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches the button to the width of its container. |
| `loading` | no | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner, marks the button busy and blocks clicks. |
| `render` | no | `ReactElement` | - | Render as another element, such as a framework link, and keep the button look. |
| `size` | no | `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` \| `custom` | `"md"` | The shared control scale; custom emits no size classes. |
| `tone` | no | `primary` \| `neutral` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `danger` \| `info` | `"primary"` | The meaning it signals, which picks its colour ramp. |
| `variant` | no | `solid` \| `soft` \| `outline` \| `ghost` \| `link` | `"solid"` | How much weight the button carries on the page. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
